Title: Business SME availability over holidays
Description: Northwind order management SMEs may be unavailable for design workshops in early January due to holiday leave.
Mitigation / Resolution: Design workshops rescheduled to weeks 2-3; SME calendar locked with Tom Harris.

Title: Azure subscription quota limits in East US 2
Description: Default vCPU and storage quotas in East US 2 are below what the migration and SIT environments need.
Mitigation / Resolution: Quota increase approved by Microsoft on 2026-02-10.

Title: Data quality in legacy customer master
Description: Data profiling found a 12% duplicate rate in the Meridian customer master, which could break order-to-customer matching after migration.
Mitigation / Resolution: Deduplication rules agreed with Northwind data owners; dedicated MDM cleansing sprint with two additional data engineers; target duplicate rate below 1% before mock run 1.

Title: DataBridge connector v3.2 delivery slipping
Description: DataBridge Solutions has slipped delivery of Oracle connector v3.2 (needed for parallel extraction) from 2026-03-13 to 2026-04-30. Further slippage would put mock run 1 and the 2026-08-17 go-live at risk.
Mitigation / Resolution: Weekly executive call with DataBridge (Kevin Walsh); service credits under SOW section 9.3; parallel evaluation of Azure Data Factory as a fallback migration tool with a go/no-go decision on the fallback by 2026-04-24.

Title: PCI DSS compliance sign-off for payment integration
Description: The payment gateway integration needs a PCI DSS assessment by Northwind's QSA before SIT can include live payment flows.
Mitigation / Resolution: QSA review booked for 2026-04-14; tokenization design reviewed in advance; card data kept out of the OMS database.

Title: Test environment contention
Description: SIT and performance testing compete for the same pre-production environment, which could compress test cycles.
Mitigation / Resolution: Second pre-production environment funded through CR-007; environment booking calendar managed by WS5.

Title: Lead data architect attrition
Description: Ravi Shankar, lead data architect on WS2, has resigned with a last working day of 2026-04-17. Loss of design knowledge could slow mock run preparation.
Mitigation / Resolution: Knowledge transfer sessions scheduled; backfill Ana Gomez joins on 2026-04-13 for a one-week overlap.

Title: Go-live slipping into retail freeze
Description: Any further slip beyond mid-October would push go-live into the November 15 to January 5 retail freeze, forcing a delay to 2027 and breaching the Dallas data center lease.
Mitigation / Resolution: Schedule buffer of 12 weeks between 2026-08-17 go-live and the freeze; monthly schedule health review at SteerCo.

Title: ExpressRoute circuit provisioning delayed
Description: The carrier delayed provisioning of the ExpressRoute circuit between the Dallas data center and Azure East US 2, blocking landing zone completion.
Mitigation / Resolution: Carrier escalation through Microsoft account team; circuit live on 2026-03-05; milestone M1 achieved 2026-03-06, one week late.

Title: Data migration throughput below requirement
Description: Performance test on 2026-02-17 showed DataBridge Migrate (connector v3.1) sustaining 18 GB per hour against a required 50 GB per hour for the 2.3 TB order history.
Mitigation / Resolution: Resolved in plan by CR-007 (go-live moved to 2026-08-17) and DEC-006 (hybrid cutover). Technical fix depends on connector v3.2.

Title: SIT environment certificate expiry
Description: TLS certificates in the SIT environment expired, breaking integration tests for two days.
Mitigation / Resolution: Certificates renewed; automated renewal enabled through Azure Key Vault.

Title: Send DataBridge formal notice of delay
Description: Issue formal written notice of delay to DataBridge Solutions to start the service credit clock under SOW section 9.3.

Title: Complete Azure Data Factory fallback proof of concept
Description: Build a proof of concept migrating one month of order history using Azure Data Factory to validate it as a fallback.

Title: Prepare Phase 2 loyalty business case
Description: Prepare a business case for loyalty module integration for Phase 2 planning.

Title: Primary Azure region
Description: East US 2 selected as the primary Azure region for the order management platform.

Title: Adopt hybrid cutover approach
Description: Pre-migrate historical orders older than 90 days ahead of cutover; migrate only open orders, the last 90 days and the final delta within the 48-hour window.

Title: Approve CR-007 go-live re-plan
Description: Go-live moved from 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-17 with a cost impact of $320,000.

Title: Reject CR-008 loyalty integration for Phase 1
Description: Loyalty module integration deferred to Phase 2.
